name: Barbell hip thrust
notes: Barbell hip extension with the upper back supported on a bench.

guide.setup: Sit with the upper back against a stable bench, the padded bar across the hip crease, and feet about shoulder width.
guide.execution: Drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes until the torso is level, then lower with control.
guide.cues: Keep ribs down. Finish with the glutes. Keep shins near vertical at the top.
guide.mistakes: Overextending the lower back; pushing from the toes; knees collapsing inward; rushing the bottom.

images.caption: Top position with hips fully extended and the bar controlled across the crease of the hips.
